Background: a hexagonal room with floor-to-ceiling mirrors on all six walls and a white mirrored floor, soft white light from above, so that her figure repeats in a ring of identical reflections that recede in six directions like a kaleidoscope, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright soft white light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
